{{Quote|I've been assigned as your advisor, and will be your eye in the sky until further notice&hellip; or we all get killed.|01/425, to Boss of Delta Squad|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
'''01/425''' was a [[Advisor/Legends|clone advisor]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He often found himself tasked with overseeing the operations of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], a [[Squad/Legends|unit]] of elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] that included [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], [[RC-1140/Legends|Fixer]], [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]], with whom he would communicate via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and the squad's in-[[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|helmet]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]]. The [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] helped them through the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during which Delta Squad [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]], disabled an underground [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factory]], and [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|raided]] a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]]. In the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the war, 01/425 guided Delta Squad throughout its [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|investigation]] of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'' in the [[Chaykin Cluster]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he also oversaw Delta Squad's [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|opening reconnaissance]] of the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], during which it freed the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-backed [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].

==Biography==
===The beginning of the war===
{{Quote|I will be issuing further orders as you go. Good luck, commando.|01/425, to Boss|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="dbct" /> 01/425<ref name="RepCom" /> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="dbct" /> for service in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. 01/425 worked as a [[Advisor/Legends|clone advisor]], a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who assisted other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during their missions. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]<ref name="RepCom" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> 01/425 was charged with overseeing the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of the elite [[Squad/Legends|unit]] [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]]&mdash;comprised of [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], [[RC-1140/Legends|RC-1140]] "Fixer," [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]]&mdash;from a location away from the battlefield during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|ensuing conflict]].<ref name="RepCom" />

Keeping in communication with the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] via a [[HoloNet transceiver/Legends|hologram projector]] that the squad members carried in the built-in [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] of their [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|helmets]], 01/425 guided Boss to meet up with the other members of the squad at separate rendezvous points across Geonosis. Along the way, 01/425 helped Boss become accustomed to his equipment and the combat zone around him, as it was Boss's first [[Time/Legends|time]] out on a real battlefield. After Boss met up with his comrades, 01/425 tasked Delta Squad with the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]]. As Delta Squad searched for Fac, 01/425 kept them up to date on the surrounding environment, in the form of traps or enemies in the area. Facing off against [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] along the way, Delta Squad caught up with Fac, and Sev shot his fleeing [[Sun Fac's starfighter|''Nantex''-class starfighter]]. Fac was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the ensuing crash.<ref name="RepCom" />

Upon its completion of the task, the squad was informed by 01/425 of the next part of its mission: disabling an underground [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factory]] on the world. After Delta Squad infiltrated the foundry, 01/425 searched the building's schematics for a weak point, which he eventually found to be two power conduits that, if destroyed, would disable the facility. Delta Squad succeeded in eliminating the conduits and disabling the factory, and 01/425 then sent the commandos to [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|raid]] a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]] and gain launch codes that would prevent an entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of Separatist Core Ships in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Geonosis from escaping the battle. Through the continued help and guidance of 01/425, Delta Squad retrieved the launch codes and destroyed the Core Ship.<ref name="RepCom" /> Shortly after, the Republic won the battle raging on Geonosis.<ref name="TNEC" />

===Mission to the ''Prosecutor''===
{{Dialogue|01/425|Her last patrol was the Corellia Sector, defending Republic trade routes against Separatist activity, but we lost contact with her over two weeks ago.|Sev|This is nowhere near Corellia! Have they gone rogue?|01/425|Not likely.|Fixer|Respectfully, sir, it could be a trap.|01/425|Indeed it could, Delta 40, which is why we're sending our most qualified squad to investigate. Someone important noted your excellence on Geonosis.|attr=01/425 informs Delta Squad of their mission to the ''Prosecutor''|src=<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:Prosecutor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Prosecutor'']]
Three hundred and sixty-seven days into the Clone Wars,<ref name="RepCom" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TNECThink">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Clone Wars started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]; 367 days afterward would place the mission to the Chaykin Cluster in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> 01/425 handled Delta Squad's [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|investigation]] of the Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'', which had reappeared in the [[Chaykin Cluster]] following a two-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long disappearance after being tasked with defending [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. 01/425 informed Delta Squad of its mission to secure the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and recover the flight records from the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} [[Datacore/Legends|data cores]]. However, once the commandos were aboard the ''Prosecutor'', communication between 01/425 and the commandos was cut off due to heavy static. Contact was reestablished after the squad reached the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and destroyed a Separatist [[Jammer/Legends|jamming device]].<ref name="RepCom" />

01/425 scanned the derelict [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] and found a [[Trandoshan dropship]] in one of the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. Delta Squad informed him that they had indeed encountered numerous [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] already, so 01/425 ordered the clones to repel the enemy. Delta Squad discovered, however, that the Trandoshans were being backed by elements of the Confederacy, which arrived to reinforce their allies with an armed [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]. While Delta Squad fought the large amount of battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] deployed by the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], 01/425 performed scans of the ship and found that it contained great amounts of information that would be vital to the Republic. 01/425 then called for Republic assistance, and he eventually got through to [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Talbot]], in command of the ''Acclamator''-class assault ship [[Arrestor (Acclamator-class)|''Arrestor'']], who came to their aid. In conjunction with Delta Squad's efforts to reactivate the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] battery, ''Arrestor'' destroyed the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] that was controlling the droids and ensured Delta Squad's mission was a success.<ref name="RepCom" />

===Operation on Kashyyyk===
{{Quote|Hold on, hold on! Advisor, what do you mean an entire operation?''"<br />"''Your team was the advance force for a full scale Republic invasion. I had strict orders not to tell you. It was ''your'' reconnaissance, ''your'' intel that verified the operation, and now the invasion has begun&hellip;|Boss and 01/425 as the Battle of Kashyyyk begins|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
In the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the war,<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> 01/425 informed Delta Squad that they would be [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|inserted]] onto the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to locate the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]], who had been captured by Separatist-backed Trandoshan [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. Once on the surface of Kashyyyk, 01/425 guided the squad through the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] to a [[Unidentified Trandoshan camp|Trandoshan camp]], where Delta Squad freed several other [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. When the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], was sighted nearby, 01/425 ordered Delta Squad to visually confirm the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General's presence. Grievous was on Kashyyyk to take Tarfful into custody, but when Delta Squad struck, he fled the planet aboard the ''Soulless One'', leaving his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] to battle Delta Squad. The commandos defeated the MagnaGuards, and as they moved onward, 01/425 oversaw their strike on another Trandoshan compound in the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr tree]] forests of Kashyyyk.<ref name="RepCom" />

However, his authority and operational tasking duties were later superseded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]'s arrival on Kashyyyk.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> Meanwhile, Delta Squad was forced to leave behind its main [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], Sev&mdash;who had come under attack and been cut off from the rest of the squad<ref name="RepCom" />&mdash;as Tur-Mukan was drawn away by the Wookiee [[Enacca]] to be taken to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="O66" /> The job of settling the angered and upset Delta Squad members, who were distraught about leaving Sev behind, fell to 01/425. He tried to help Delta Squad by relaying a message from [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] through the squad's [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] projector, before reassigning Delta Squad with a new objective as the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] truly began.<ref name="RepCom" /> Although the Battle of Kashyyyk ended with a Republic victory,<ref name="RotS" /> [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency order]] for all of the Republic's clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to immediately execute their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Generals,<ref name="O66" /> was issued during the battle and resulted in [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|many deaths]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Three-Eight, get your squad under control! One commando is not worth jeopardizing an entire operation!''"<br />"''One commando?! He's talking about my pod brother!|01/425 and Scorch, after Delta Squad is forced to leave Sev behind|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:Adviser.jpg|thumb|right|250px|01/425 speaks with Delta Squad.]]
01/425 was a clone [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]<ref name="RepCom" /> who stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="dbct" /> He was a levelheaded soldier and expert tactician, proving a valuable asset to Delta Squad on every mission with which he was tasked to assist it. Remaining calm and collected, 01/425 was often able to find efficient, if often improvised, solutions to problems facing Delta Squad in the field. He frequently helped Delta Squad find new ways around obstacles and enemies that would come up unexpectedly. He also spoke [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]], as he could quickly translate for the Wookiee allies Delta Squad encountered on Kashyyyk. 01/425 possessed a dry and cynical sense of humor. Though he never hassled Delta Squad members Sev or Scorch for their incessant chatter and back-and-forth quips, he demanded that the squad be professional when such conduct was needed. He was also strongly pragmatic, believing that the loss of a single clone commando was acceptable in the scope of successfully completing a major operation. After Delta Squad was forced to leave Sev behind, 01/425 tried to help the angered commandos by telling them to get a hold on their emotions.<ref name="RepCom" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|I'm contacting the Republic for assistance.|01/425|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
01/425 wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] throughout the war, rather than changing to [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]].<ref name="RepCom" /> Even during the Battle of Kashyyyk, when most clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] had made the switch to Phase II [[Armor/Legends|armor]],<ref name="RotS" /> he still retained his Phase I armor. Like most clone troopers, he had an in-helmet comlink that he used to communicate with Delta Squad. He also had equipment that was capable of calling in Republic support, which is what he did during Delta Squad's mission in the Chaykin [[Star cluster/Legends|Cluster]].<ref name="RepCom" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Squad, regroup! We're going after Sev!''"<br />"''Negative, negative, 38! New orders came through from the Jedi Generals! Clear the area! Evac now!''"<br />"''I don't care if they came from Master Yoda himself!''"<br />"''As a matter of fact, they ''did'', soldier. Now get your squad out of there.|Boss and 01/425 in ''Star Wars: Republic Commando'' after Sev goes missing|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
01/425 first appeared in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', which was released on [[March 1]], [[2005]]. Despite appearing in a rather prominent role in the game,<ref name="RepCom" /> he was left out of the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels by author [[Karen Traviss]]. The actions of Delta Squad are only one aspect of the series, but when the novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']] comes to Delta Squad's mission on Kashyyyk, 01/425 is still absent from the narrative. His lines during Sev's abandoning are attributed to a different clone character altogether, General [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos's]] [[Forward Air Controller/Legends|Forward Air Controller]].<ref name="O66" /> This article documents 01/425's involvement throughout the Kashyyyk mission as portrayed in the game but favors ''Order 66''{{'s}} attribution of those few lines, as it is presented in the more recent source.
